mapper.sql: FROM doctor_schedule sc JOIN doctor d ON d.id = sc.doctor_id JOIN department dp ON dp.id = d.department_id

SELECT sc.id, dp.id AS department_id, dp.name AS department_name, sc.doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, sc.schedule_date, sc.clinic_period, sc.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_slot s WHERE s.schedule_id = sc.id) AS slots, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_slot s WHERE s.schedule_id = sc.id AND s.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND s.start_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND sc.status = 'OPEN' AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND dp.status = 'ACTIVE') AS remaining, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment a JOIN appointment_slot s ON s.id = a.slot_id WHERE s.schedule_id = sc.id AND a.status IN ('BOOKED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'VISITED')) AS booked, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM schedule_interruption i WHERE i.schedule_id=sc.id) AS interrupted
mapper.select:
SELECT id, code, name, description, status
ORDER BY name, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT dp.id, dp.name, dp.status FROM department dp WHERE ORDER BY dp.name, dp.id
ORDER BY sc.schedule_date DESC, sc.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
